mapper.select: select * from Pro_Project_Register where id = #{id} for update
select mn.*, sf.file_relation_id from Pro_Project_Register mn left join SYS_File sf on sf.fileid = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}

select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when mn.state is not null and mn.state not in (0, 3, 7) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as approving, coalesce(sum(case when mn.state = 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as approved from Pro_Project_Register mn
and exists (select 1 from SYS_User permission_user where permission_user.U_ID = mn.create_uid and permission_user.C_ID = #{params.permissionCompanyId})
